phases.name: Opening war
phases.blurb: US–Israeli strikes on Iran; Iranian missile waves on Israel and Gulf hosts; Hormuz traffic collapses by roughly 70%.
phases.source: Wikipedia: 2026 Iran war; Al Jazeera, 8 Apr

phases.name: Ceasefire & first blockade
phases.blurb: Pakistan-brokered truce from 8 Apr, broken by clashes. US blockades Iranian ports from 13 Apr after the Islamabad talks fail; Trump says on 29 May it will lift, but it stays until the MoU.
phases.source: Al Jazeera, 8 Apr; TWZ, 29 May; USNI, 18 Jun

phases.name: MoU interlude
phases.blurb: 17 Jun Trump–Pezeshkian MoU promises 60 days of free transit; CENTCOM lifts the blockade on 18 Jun. Reopening stays partial and clashes resume within weeks.
phases.source: JINSA; USNI, 18 Jun; Wikipedia: 2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis

phases.name: Blockade war
phases.blurb: Trump declares the MoU over on 8 Jul; US blockade reimposed 14 Jul; Houthis declare a blockade of Saudi Arabia 20 Jul; Iran's biggest salvo since April (≥70 missiles and drones, 31 Aug–2 Sep).
phases.source: Korea JoongAng Daily, 9 Jul; USNI / NPR, 13–14 Jul; Al Jazeera, 20 Jul; JINSA, 2 Sep

phases.name: Tanker war
phases.blurb: Near-daily IRGC attacks on merchant ships since 29 Sep; October the worst month of the war; limpet mines and US strikes on Qeshm; mid-Nov Iran resumes fire at US bases in Bahrain and Kuwait.
phases.source: ISW/CTP, 5 Oct; Reuters via Gulf Times, 24 Oct; UKMTO; JINSA, 18 Nov

phases.name: Settlement
phases.blurb: Talks produce a text; ship attacks fall while transits climb under an agreed regime. The dashboard's end-signal is the tell.

phases.name: Cessation
phases.blurb: Ship attacks near zero, transits back toward the pre-war ~120–135 a day, blockade lifted.

events.title: War begins
events.note: Coordinated US–Israeli strikes on Iran; Iran retaliates across the Gulf and Hormuz traffic collapses. (Wikipedia: 2026 Iran war / Strait of Hormuz crisis)

events.title: Two-week ceasefire
events.note: Pakistan-mediated US–Iran ceasefire; it holds in some form until 8 Jul. (Wikipedia: 2026 Iran war ceasefire)

events.title: US blockade of Iranian ports
events.note: Ordered after the Islamabad talks fail. Trump says on 29 May it will lift, but NAVCENT keeps it in force; CENTCOM ends it on 18 Jun under the MoU. (USNI, 18 Jun; TWZ, 29 May) [corrected 20 Nov: earlier note said it ran to 29 May]

events.title: US–Iran exchange fire under truce
events.note: US strikes Iranian sites after clashes in Hormuz. (CNN, NYT via Wikipedia)

events.title: Trump–Pezeshkian MoU
events.note: 60-day memorandum to end the war and reopen Hormuz. (JINSA)

events.title: US lifts first blockade
events.note: CENTCOM ends the blockade of Iranian ports under the 17 Jun MoU. (USNI, 18 Jun)

events.title: MoU declared over
events.note: Iran strikes commercial ships; Trump calls the MoU 'over' and fire resumes. (JINSA; Wikipedia)

events.title: US blockade reimposed
events.note: CENTCOM resumes blockade of Iranian ports. (JINSA citing CENTCOM)

events.title: Houthis declare blockade on Saudi Arabia
events.note: Effective immediately; opens the Saudi front. (Al Jazeera, 20 Jul; UKMTO weekly overview) [date corrected 20 Nov from 22 Jul]

events.title: US strikes; Iran's biggest salvo since July
events.note: 70 Iranian missiles/drones on 31 Aug – 2 Sep at Jordan, Bahrain, Iraq, Kuwait. (JINSA 2 Sep)

events.title: Near-daily ship attacks begin
events.note: ISW/CTP dates the start of near-daily Iranian attacks on merchant shipping to 29 Sep; Kpler counts 10 tankers hit 28 Sep–4 Oct. (ISW/CTP Iran Update, 5 Oct)

events.title: Record week of ship attacks
events.note: 12 vessels hit 5–11 Oct, six on 11 Oct alone; October becomes the worst month of the war. (UKMTO via BBC Verify; Washington Institute)

events.title: Brent hits $115
events.note: First time since May. (JINSA 23 Oct)

events.title: First limpet-mine attack
events.note: Small boat attaches two charges to tanker Louise 1 off Khasab. (UKMTO via Reuters/Iran International)

events.title: US strikes Qeshm, Hengam, Bandar Abbas
events.note: Unannounced 'defensive' strikes on SAM sites; same day Iran floats a two-day Hormuz reopening. (AP via PBS/Washington Post; JINSA)

events.title: US midterms
events.note: Democrats take the House; Tehran reads it as a Republican defeat. (AP; Maritime Executive)

events.title: IRGC claims four tankers mined, two ships seized
events.note: Claimed mine strikes south of the strait plus two seizures; unverified. (JINSA 4 Nov)

events.title: US hits Qeshm air defences again
events.note: Trump confirms 'minor strikes'; Iran weighs Qatari proposals. (AP via Washington Post; RFE/RL)

events.title: IRGC lifts 2,000 km missile-range cap
events.note: Announced by IRGC spokesman Mohebbi. (RFE/RL citing Iranian media)

events.title: US disables blockade-runner M/V Huda
events.note: St Kitts-flagged tanker disabled after leaving an Iranian port. (ISW/CTP Iran Update, 8 Nov)

events.title: Houthi missiles at Riyadh
events.note: Intercepted; falling debris damages the Aramco tower. Tanker struck outbound in Hormuz the night before. (Saudi Energy Ministry via ABC News / Iran International; UKMTO)

events.title: Trump: new strikes 'highly unlikely'; Rubio: no breakthrough
events.note: Trump tells CNN strikes are unlikely while talks progress; Rubio calls Iran's terms unrealistic before the G7 in Paris. (ISW/CTP; Fox News citing Reuters)

events.title: IRGC says southern-lane navigation aids destroyed
events.note: IRGC Navy official tells state media no unauthorised vessels transited overnight. (Reuters via Arab News)

events.title: Qatar PM brings Iran's interim Hormuz terms to Trump
events.note: White House meeting; reported terms (Israel Hayom, unconfirmed): reopen Hormuz and halt tanker attacks for lifting the blockade and releasing $8bn. Brent Jan falls ~6% to the low $92s. (Fox News; OK Energy Today)

events.title: Houthis fire at Riyadh, Abqaiq and East-West Pipeline
events.note: Saudi Arabia says it intercepted two ballistic and cruise missiles near Riyadh, one ballistic missile in the Eastern Province and a drone; Saudi jets hit the Houthi-held Yemen Petroleum Company HQ in Sanaa. Same day a projectile hits an Emirati-operated tanker. (ISW/CTP Iran Update, 10 Nov)

events.title: Brent below $90 for first time since August
events.note: Follows Trump's 9 Nov remarks that renewed strikes are 'quite unlikely' and Iran 'militarily is effectively over'; Qatar says mediated talks are making progress. (JINSA Iran War Update, 12–13 Nov)

events.title: Tanker engine room hit off Ras al-Khaimah
events.note: Strike ~14 nm NW of Ras al-Khaimah, crew evacuated; UKMTO's weekly overview counts 7 tanker attacks in the week to 11 Nov. (UKMTO via Middle East Eye)

events.title: Trump pulls Vance off Iran: 'we don't need a deal'
events.note: Truth Social post says the US already has 'their money' and 'their Strait'; Iran's Rezaei demands acceptance of Iran's seven conditions. (JINSA Iran War Update, 11–12 Nov)

events.title: IRGC strikes US radar in Bahrain
events.note: Retaliation for a 12 Nov strike on a telecom tower in Sirik; first Iranian strike on US equipment in a Gulf state since September. CENTCOM rejects the IRGC's damage claims. IRGC repeats with six drones at Al-Riffa on 15 Nov. (JINSA Iran War Update, 13 and 16 Nov)

events.title: Third US carrier arrives in region
events.note: USS Roosevelt brings the count to three carrier strike groups; Reuters reports Trump may hold off on new strikes if Iran and the Houthis don't provoke. (Axios and Reuters via JINSA, 16 Nov)

events.title: Houthis push toward Aden after IRG pullback
events.note: Yemeni government forces withdraw from the Bab el-Mandeb coast; Houthis advance to within ~37 miles of Aden. (JINSA Iran War Update, 16 Nov)

events.title: Outbound tanker hit by projectile in Hormuz
events.note: Engine-room fire, no casualties; Tehran separately bars IAEA access to damaged nuclear sites until the war ends. (UKMTO via Iran International; JINSA, 16 Nov)

events.title: US hits Qeshm launch site; Iran fires at Bahrain and Kuwait
events.note: US strike on an IRGC missile site after drones were fired at a US asset; Iran launches three attacks on Bahrain and one on Kuwait on 17–18 Nov, its first fire at Kuwait since early September. (JINSA Iran War Update, 18 Nov)

events.title: Outbound tanker hit off Khasab
events.note: Projectile strikes the engine room ~6 nm north of Khasab; crew safe. Third tanker hit near Khasab in three days. (UKMTO via JINSA, 20 Nov)

events.title: Senate rejects war-powers limit; Trump 'not rushing'
events.note: 48–51 vote; Trump tells Axios he will 'see what happens after the beginning of the year'. Pentagon puts the war's cost at $48bn. (JINSA Iran War Update, 20 Nov)

events.title: IRGC claims two supertankers mined
events.note: IRGC says two VLCCs hit mines and exploded in the strait; unverified. Same day a US official claims a war-time high of ~28m barrels through Hormuz. (Iran International; i24 via JINSA, 20 Nov)

events.title: USS George Washington leaves the Middle East
events.note: Two carrier strike groups remain in the region. (JINSA Iran War Update, 20 Nov)

events.title: Tanker on fire after projectile strike near Hormuz
events.note: Outbound tanker struck ~8 nm north of Khasab and catches fire, no casualties; the IRGC says it hit a mine. CBS reports the US and Israel are weighing new military action. (UKMTO via Reuters, 20 Nov; CBS via JINSA, 20 Nov)

events.title: Qatari delegation holds talks in Tehran
events.note: Deputy FM Gharibabadi says the two sides held two hours of talks, no details given. (Iranian state media via Gulf News, 22–23 Nov)

events.title: Two tankers hit by projectiles off Khasab
events.note: UKMTO reports an engine-room hit 17 nm east and a stern hit 11 nm north of Khasab; the first may be the Saudi-owned LUJAIN (Starboard). JMIC counts seven tankers hit since 16 Nov. (UKMTO via ISW/CTP Iran Update, 21 Nov; JMIC via Gulf News)

events.title: IRGC strikes Bahrain; Sitra industrial site on fire
events.note: Bahrain's interior ministry says a civilian industrial facility on Sitra was hit, no casualties; IRGC claims it targeted US bases at Sheikh Isa and Juffair. Further Iranian attacks intercepted on 22 Nov, two people injured. CENTCOM denies an IRGC claim of hitting a US F-16. (Bahrain interior ministry and Fars via Gulf News; ABC News)

events.title: Tanker incident 'involving military forces' near Chabahar
events.note: UKMTO reports an incident close to the US blockade line in the Gulf of Oman, investigations ongoing; Tehran talks of 14 tankers at Kharg preparing to run the blockade and threatens Gulf energy sites if the US stops them. (UKMTO via Euronews and ABC News, 22 Nov; Gulf News)

events.title: Trump: military action resumes after New Year without a deal
events.note: Tells Fox News the US will resume military action if there is no deal after the New Year and that blockade-runners will be 'at the bottom of the sea'. (Fox News via Gulf News and Euronews, 22 Nov)

launches.label: Iranian launches
launches.meaning: Iranian missiles + drones launched per week (JINSA tally since 7 Jul, weekly difference). Excludes Houthi fire and IRGC strikes on ships. Near-zero = ability-to-hurt is gone.
sources: JINSA Iran War Updates (cumulative 'launched since July 7')

interference.label: Ship attacks (UKMTO-verified)
interference.meaning: Attacks on merchant ships in Hormuz, the Gulf and Gulf of Oman verified by UKMTO in its weekly overview. UKMTO says most attacked ships no longer report, so this is a floor (Lloyd's List / Washington Institute counts run higher). The true endgame gauge — this falling is the war actually ending.
sources: UKMTO Voluntary Reporting Area Weekly Overview

transits.label: Hormuz transits
transits.meaning: All vessel transits of the Strait (in + out), UKMTO weekly total ÷ 7: AIS-observed plus US-reported facilitated transits (the US share, ~80% of the total, can't be independently verified). UKMTO's own '65–75% below pre-conflict' implies a pre-war rate of roughly 120–135/day on this count.
sources: UKMTO Voluntary Reporting Area Weekly Overview
Lloyd's List Intelligence Strait of Hormuz Brief

vlcc.label: VLCC completions
vlcc.meaning: Very Large Crude Carriers completing a loaded Hormuz exit. No free weekly count is published (Kpler/Vortexa paywalled); left empty rather than estimated. S&P Global Commodities at Sea says VLCC transits fell sharply in October; the IMO lists 11 VLCCs damaged in October.

backwardation.label: Brent backwardation (M1-M3)
backwardation.meaning: Brent term structure snapshot, taken Monday when markets reopen. Backwardation (M1 > deferred) = physical tightness. Backwardation EASING (spread shrinking toward 0 / flipping to contango) = tightness relaxing before any headline says so. Update 'curve' each Monday with front-month settlement out to M6, and append the M1-M3 spread to 'spread_history'. Source used: NYMEX Brent Last Day Financial (BZ) contract closes via Yahoo Finance (tickers BZF27.NYM … BZM27.NYM), which track ICE Brent settlements; cross-check with ICE / Barchart. Seed history replaced 2026-11-08. Earlier Mondays could not be reconstructed: the Dec-26 contract that was M1 until 30 Oct has expired and its history is no longer served.
